findings.description: compose.yaml edit in commit c90203f accidentally deleted alloy and otel-collector-dora service headers, merging their properties into loki and causing duplicate deploy key at line 136
Five unit tests failed due to alloy service missing from compose.yaml after botched edit
All downstream CI jobs (Validate, Pre-flight, Acceptance Smoke, Pipeline Complete) were cascading failures from the compose.yaml YAML parse error

decision: Surgically restored compose.yaml to main version then removed only otel-collector healthcheck block (12 lines) with distroless comment (2 lines). All 242 unit tests pass. Fix pushed to fix/acceptance-test-sli001-sli006.

findings.description: AGENTS.md commit 34d673b added three ### subheadings without blank lines after them, violating markdownlint MD022 rule enforced in CI pre-commit hooks
Pre-flight CI job and Validate CI job both failed on markdownlint hook — markdownlint auto-fixed files causing hook to report failure

decision: Added blank lines after three ### subheadings in AGENTS.md lines 192, 202, 207. markdownlint now clean. All CI jobs passing.

findings.description: deploy.yml YAML syntax errors: 10 instances of unquoted run values containing colon-space sequences (job-start:, job-finish:) causing 'mapping values are not allowed here' at line 38 column 29
Markdownlint MD022 violations: AGENTS.md (3 subheadings) and DEPLOYMENT_STRATEGY.md (2 subheadings) missing blank lines after ### headings
Secret detection false positives: deploy.yml echo statements referencing DEPLOY_HOST/DEPLOY_USER/DEPLOY_KEY flagged as potential secrets — regenerated baseline

Concurrency collision: ci-acceptance-smoke.yml triggered twice per PR push — directly via pull_request AND via workflow_call from ci-pipeline.yml — both sharing concurrency group acceptance-smoke-ref causing mutual cancellation and 'No test results file found' errors

decision: Fixed 4 categories of failures: (1) quoted 10 YAML run values with colon-space sequences, (2) added blank lines after 5 ### subheadings, (3) regenerated secrets baseline, (4) removed pull_request trigger from ci-acceptance-smoke.yml to eliminate double-trigger concurrency collision. All CI checks now passing (Validate, Pre-flight, Unit Tests, Acceptance Smoke, Pipeline Complete).
